author: /root/dependency_inventory
scope: Exactly the first-batch 32 new Lean files from the 30 TASKS entries and their actual direct source import declarations. This is a source inventory and installation suggestion, not compilation or full transitive dependency closure.
resolution_policy: Read each first-batch source import declaration, ignoring source comments and strings; verify it against the TASKS snapshot.
Prefer exact path and SHA pins in that candidate task registry; cross-check duplicate pins from all cohort users of a direct module.
Resolve only exact pinned paths or deterministic production module paths. Do not search or choose a held draft by a same-name match.
Mark AMBIGUOUS when exact source candidates are not unique; mark MISSING when no exact local source is available.
Mathlib revision comes from lake-manifest.json; absent package files have null source SHA and MISSING status. No external library is copied or fetched.
not_performed: No installation, copying, production change, first-batch source mutation, Git operation or quota inspection.
No recursive held dependency import closure or third-party theorem/kernel acceptance audit.
